max_depth truncates content beyond the specified depth

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"max_depth\":3}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<div><p>Shallow</p><div><div><div><p>Too deep</p></div></div></div></div>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
